name: codex-usage-pet
description: A local-first Windows desktop pet that displays remaining Codex usage.

interface.shortDescription: Keep track of your remaining Codex usage with 10 pet themes.
interface.longDescription: Your selected theme appears in the edge avatar, compact usage view, and full details view. The details view includes theme, settings, refresh, and power buttons; the pet avatar is decorative. The settings gear selects the main remaining percentage: lowest remaining (default), 5-hour, or weekly. Apply saves the choice and updates the display; Cancel, Back, or Escape discards unapplied changes. Choose from 10 pet themes using the theme button. Drag the compact or details view near any screen edge to tuck it away as a small avatar. Usage data is read through the local Codex app-server. The pet does not access auth.json or upload data to third parties.
defaultPrompt: Start the usage pet automatically when I sign in to Windows.
Check whether the usage pet can read my Codex usage.
